sources.snippet: What is AI Release Tracker? AI Release Tracker is a free, continuously updated timeline of every major AI model release from the world's leading AI labs. It currently tracks 230 models from 10 companies — including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta, SpaceXAI, DeepSeek, Mistral, Moonshot AI, Z.ai, and Qwen — from the launch of ChatGPT on November 30 2022 through today.
